plugins.name: Toolbox Framework (Host registry + Client panel shell)
plugins.purpose: Toolbox framework: the Host half maintains the tool registry and provides the toolbox/tools and toolbox/panel RPC; the Client half provides the drawer + Tab bar + generic HTML panel shell (the only new-architecture plugin that needs browser approval)

plugins.name: Live Flowglass (Host-only)
plugins.purpose: Host-only: live flowgraph of the current session—a top-down arrow spine (user/assistant/tool groups), subagent git-tree branches (├─ branches expand sub-session steps live, ╰─ merge), plain calls synced as parallel cards; the panel carries data-autorefresh=2000 and the framework silently re-pulls every 2s; makeSessionLogReader caches per session
